title: German saucer airframe with boundary-layer suction vents

tellings.quote: So they came up with the idea of creating a saucer-shaped craft that would have suction vents all around it.

plain: In Germany, sometime in the 1930s or 40s, engineers are said to have come up with a saucer-shaped craft with suction vents all around its edge, meant to pull in the thin layer of air flowing over the surface. The researcher Jason Jorjani describes this without naming a source, in an episode about what he calls Hitler's secret UFO program. He tells it as evidence that Germany was working on real saucer-shaped aircraft.
